Confirms the shared _prepare/component restriction did not perturb valid connected-graph numerics

decisions: Dispatcher (two_terminal_resistance) operates on the backend-neutral edge list [(u,v,r),...] already shared by the CG/SciPy backends, not on v0.13's adjacency+rfun (a network-layer shape, ARCH-004/Session 07), keeping core/solver pure and backend-independent while reproducing v0.13's dense/sparse crossover exactly.
Dense two-terminal path re-derived from an edge list to build the same grounded conductance matrix and return V[dst]; verified equal to v0.13 network_resistance within 1e-12.

All backends and the dense dispatcher use sorted(nodes, key=str) node ordering (v0.13's CG/SciPy convention), giving deterministic output; float differences vs v0.13's dict-order dense path are ~1e-15, inside V11 tolerances.
Extracted functions given clean public names with provenance recorded in docstrings; behavior, epsilons, and tie-breaks copied verbatim (Session 03 precedent).
BASE-005 marked closed because its Done-when is documentation of a decision + thresholds, fully within this session's owned scope (unlike Session 03's PWR-001, which needed cross-session modules).

REPAIR (CHANGES_REQUESTED): consistency enforced structurally via one shared helper _prepare(edges, src, dst) that every edge-list backend and the auto dispatcher call - it validates resistances, checks endpoint presence and src!=dst, restricts to src's connected component (v0.13's sorted(key=str) order), and requires dst in it. Backends cannot drift apart on edge cases, and parity holds because for a connected graph the helper is a no-op on the node set/order.

REPAIR: src==dst raises ValueError('source and sink are the same node') rather than returning a self-consistent 0.0 - a self-resistance query is far more likely a caller error, and a loud named error matches the other degenerate-input handling (v0.13 raised a bare KeyError here).

REPAIR: non-finite (NaN/inf) resistances now raise on every backend ('non-finite resistance in network'); v0.13 handled them inconsistently (dense poisoned the matrix via 1/NaN, sparse silently dropped). Non-positive (r<=0) and self-loop edges are still dropped exactly as v0.13, so valid connected-graph parity is unaffected. Carrying 'open' as inf is unsupported; omit the edge.

REPAIR: solve_cg now checks convergence and raises 'conjugate-gradient solve did not converge' if the residual never reaches tol within maxit, instead of returning the last iterate. For the SPD grounded Laplacian of a connected component CG always converges well within maxit, so this never fires for valid inputs (V11/V20 unchanged).
